documents.text: Pressing the emergency stop opens the safety relay and immediately disconnects electrical power to the drive motor. A normal software stop slows the motor while the safety relay remains closed, so it does not disconnect motor power.
The battery coolant pump circulates liquid through cold plates to transfer cell heat to a radiator. Passenger cabin air conditioning uses a separate air circuit.
The synthetic warranty period is two years from purchase. This record belongs only to another collection.
